snippet.title: Vartio | Official Trailer & Release Date Reveal | Steam
snippet.description:
Vartio (Finnish for “Patrol”) drops you into the boots of a medieval guardsman assigned to a solitary night watch. Your duty: patrol the shadowy forests surrounding a remote watchtower and report back to your commander. 
But something is wrong out there. And it’s getting closer.

🌲 Wishlist on Steam Now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3639120/Vartio/

🎯Discord: https://discord.gg/xd6a85G3
